Mailing Lists & Data Services

You're not losing customers because your message is wrong. You're losing them because you're mailing the wrong people. We build targeted lists that actually reach people — cleaned, verified, and ready to mail.

Cornerstone provides targeted mailing data lists for Hudson Valley direct mail campaigns — consumer demographics, B2B firmographics, NCOA-cleaned addresses, and custom geographic segmentation. A mailing list is the foundation of any direct mail campaign: it determines who receives your piece and, in turn, what response rate you see. We source from multiple list providers, run NCOA and address verification before delivery, and integrate the list directly into your campaign production workflow.

Hudson Valley businesses have trusted us with 2.3 million pieces since 1998. We don't sell you a list and disappear. We build your list, process it, mail it, and track what worked. Same team, same building, same phone number for 28 years.

The Problem with Most Mailing Lists

Most list vendors hand you a spreadsheet and call it done. You're left figuring out:

  • How many addresses are outdated
  • Who moved in the last four years
  • Which records are duplicates
  • Whether the addresses are even deliverable
  • How to format everything for the post office
  • If you're accidentally mailing your own customers

Then you mail it. Half the pieces bounce. You spent $2,000 on printing and postage, and 40% of it never arrived.

We don't sell you raw data and walk away. We hand you a file that's been NCOA-processed, CASS-certified, deduplicated, and presorted. Every address has been verified. You're not guessing if it will deliver — we already checked.

How We Build Your List (The Actual Process)

You tell us who you want to reach. We pull the data, clean it, verify every address, and deliver a mail-ready file. Here's what happens behind the scenes:

1

We Pull From National Databases

Consumer lists filter by geography, income, age, homeowner status, buying behavior, and 40+ other demographics. Business lists filter by SIC/NAICS code, employee count, revenue, and location. You want every dentist in Dutchess County? Done. Homeowners in a 5-mile radius making $75K+? We'll have the count in two hours.

2

We Run NCOA (National Change of Address)

This catches anyone who moved in the last 48 months and updates their address. The USPS requires this for presorted mail. If you skip it, your mailing gets rejected or charges full postage. We don't skip it. Every list we deliver has been NCOA-processed.

3

CASS Certification (Address Verification)

CASS stands for Coding Accuracy Support System. It's USPS software that checks every address against their master database. If an address doesn't exist, it gets flagged. If it's formatted wrong, we fix it. This is how you qualify for automation discounts — which can cut your postage by 30–50%. Without CASS, you pay retail rates on every piece.

4

Deduplication

We identify duplicate records and remove them. You're not paying to mail the same person twice. If you have an existing customer list, we'll merge/purge it against the purchased list. This keeps you from accidentally mailing people who already buy from you — which is both expensive and annoying.

5

Presort by ZIP Code

We sort your list by ZIP code to qualify for bulk postage rates. This alone saves most campaigns 30–40% on postage. On a 5,000-piece mailing, that's $400–$600 you keep instead of giving to the post office.

List Types We Provide

Saturation Lists

Every deliverable address on selected carrier routes. Ideal for EDDM and hyper-local campaigns. No demographic filters — just blanket coverage of a geographic area.

Direct Mail Lists

Consumer Lists

Filtered by age, income, homeownership, marital status, presence of children, lifestyle interests, purchase behavior, vehicle ownership, and dozens of other selects. If you need to reach "homeowners aged 45–65 making $100K+ within 10 miles of New Paltz," we can build that.

View Consumer Lists →

Business Lists

Targeted by SIC/NAICS code (industry classification), employee count, revenue range, and geography. Want every HVAC contractor in Orange County with 5–20 employees? Every pediatric practice in the Hudson Valley? We pull from Dun & Bradstreet, InfoUSA, and Experian Business.

New Mover Lists

Recently relocated households. These are high-value prospects because they're actively looking for local services — lawn care, HVAC, dental, auto repair, internet, insurance. New movers convert 3–5x higher than standard consumer lists.

View New Mover Lists →

Voter Files

Registered voter data for political mailings, municipal notifications, and advocacy campaigns. Includes voting history, party affiliation, and household composition.

Custom Compiled Lists

Specialty lists built from multiple sources. If you need something specific that doesn't fit a standard category, we compile it manually. Examples: every nonprofit with an annual budget over $500K, every business that filed for a construction permit in the last six months, every household that recently purchased solar panels.

Already Have a List? We'll Clean It.

If you already have a customer list, prospect database, or purchased file from somewhere else, we can process it for direct mail. We accept data in Excel, CSV, Access, or any database export format. We'll:

  • Run NCOA to update moved addresses
  • CASS-certify for deliverability
  • Remove duplicates
  • Standardize formatting
  • Presort by ZIP code
  • Return a mail-ready file

This service is included when you print and mail with us. If you're only processing a list (not mailing), we charge $75 per 1,000 records.

We also offer merge/purge — combining multiple lists while removing duplicates. If you have three separate spreadsheets of prospects and customers, we'll combine them into one clean file.

What You Actually Get

A spreadsheet (Excel or CSV) with these fields:

  • Full name
  • Street address (standardized to USPS format)
  • City, State, ZIP+4
  • Barcode assignment (for automation discounts)
  • NCOA move status (if applicable)
  • Deliverability score

If you're printing and mailing with us, we take that file and run it directly through our inkjet addressing system. You don't touch it. We just need your approval on the design and we're mailing. If you're using the list elsewhere, we send you the file and you're done.

Pricing (The Real Numbers)

  • Consumer Lists: $75–$125 per 1,000 names, depending on the selects
  • Business Lists: $125–$200 per 1,000 names
  • New Mover Lists: $150 per 1,000 names
  • Saturation Lists: $40–$60 per 1,000 addresses (no demographic filtering)

Pricing includes one-time use for a single mailing. Multi-use licenses are available.

NCOA processing, CASS certification, deduplication, and presort are included in every list we deliver. You're not paying extra for clean data — that's just how we do it.

Common Questions

Can you suppress my existing customers from a purchased list?

Yes. Send us your customer file (Excel or CSV). We'll scrub it against the purchased list and remove any matches. This is included at no extra charge when you print and mail with us.

How accurate are the lists?

After NCOA and CASS processing, deliverability is typically 96–98%. Some addresses will still be undeliverable (vacant homes, business closures, data entry errors), but we've removed the vast majority of bad addresses before you mail.

Can I use the list more than once?

Standard pricing is for one-time use. Multi-use licenses are available — just let us know how many times you plan to mail the list. Pricing adjusts accordingly.

What if I only need 200 names?

Most list vendors have minimums of 1,000–5,000 names. We don't. If you need 200 names, we'll pull 200 names. You pay for what you use.

Do you rent lists or sell them?

We rent them. You're licensing the data for a specific mailing. The list provider embeds seed addresses (decoys) to monitor usage. If you mail the list multiple times without a multi-use license, they'll know — and they'll charge you.

Can you target businesses by how long they've been in operation?

Yes. Business lists include "years in business" as a selectable field. This is useful if you're targeting established companies (5+ years) or startups (0–2 years).

Can I get phone numbers or email addresses?

Consumer lists can include phone numbers (landline and cellular). Business lists include phone, email, and website URL. Email append services are available if you only have mailing addresses and want to add email.

4

If you're just buying the list, we email you a cleaned, mail-ready file within 24 hours. If you're printing and mailing with us, we skip the file delivery and go straight to production.
